questions: If multiple walkways are possible at the same floor, can Takahashi choose any of them arbitrarily, or is there a specific rule (like always choose the one that minimizes stairs later)?
When moving via walkway, does the walkway move itself count as a stair use, or is it free?
If a building has exactly X floors, can Takahashi move to the X-th floor of an adjacent building via walkway from the X-th floor of the current building?
Can Takahashi move multiple times via walkways consecutively without using stairs in between?
Is the goal to minimize total stair uses across all movements, including possible intermediate stair movements within buildings not directly between start and end floors?
If Takahashi is on a floor where no adjacent building has at least that many floors, must he use stairs to change floor before using a walkway?
Are the queries independent, or can state from previous queries be reused (like caching)?
If start and end are in the same building but different floors, is the answer simply |Y_i - Z_i|, or could using walkways to other buildings and back reduce stair usage?
